findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shodan_internetdb_zero_key_ip_port_cve_scanner, linkedin_profile_company_enricher_no_cookies, linkedin_b2b_executive_finder_verified_email, x_twitter_public_search_tweets_scraper · Private data: dex_token_scanner_security_auditor, b2b_email_deliverability_dmarc_spf_bimi_auditor, multichain_wallet_aml_risk_screener, b2b_company_techstack_contacts_enricher, b2b_company_decision_maker_email_finder · Public sink: b2b_email_deliverability_dmarc_spf_bimi_auditor, b2b_leads_finder_verified_emails, b2b_company_decision_maker_email_finder, linkedin_b2b_executive_finder_verified_email, google_maps_places_emails_all_in_one, instagram_profile_posts_all_in_one.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shodan_internetdb_zero_key_ip_port_cve_scanner, linkedin_profile_company_enricher_no_cookies, linkedin_b2b_executive_finder_verified_email, x_twitter_public_search_tweets_scraper · Private data: dex_token_scanner_security_auditor, b2b_email_deliverability_dmarc_spf_bimi_auditor, multichain_wallet_aml_risk_screener, b2b_company_techstack_contacts_enricher, b2b_company_decision_maker_email_finder · Public sink: b2b_email_deliverability_dmarc_spf_bimi_auditor, b2b_leads_finder_verified_emails, b2b_company_decision_maker_email_finder, linkedin_b2b_executive_finder_verified_email, google_maps_places_emails_all_in_one, instagram_profile_posts_all_in_one

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
